== Exact published English Set 11 text ==
After free lightsaber deployment, Gold authorizes two weapons in battle. The remaster removes the stated battle qualifier. Other weapon use still follows ordinary targeting and timing rules. Both retain the same Epic Duel target permission, defense and immunity. [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/download/file.php?id=16604#page=2 Players Committee original sheet, p. 2, slip 26].
